{{Quote|Either we turn a profit on this run, or we think about going to the Hutts for another loan.|Ellin Lah|<ref name="DP" />}}
'''Ellin Lah''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''[[Woebegone]]'' in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'll say it again: this ship operates as a democracy. I’m your captain because knowing who’s good at what is just something I have a talent for.|Ellin Lah|<ref name="DP" />}}
[[File:DarthPlagueisHS-SWI130.jpg|right|thumb|200px|Plagueis, Lah's murderer.]]
Sometime in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], Ellin Lah and her crew were on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]]. The ship, the ''Woebegone'' was holding cargo that belonged to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. They noticed there was a temperature change in Cargo 4. Thinking it could be a stowaway, they turned on the vid feed and discovered that the stowaway was an injured [[Muun/Legends|Muun]]. They did not know that this Muun was [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. The crew asked the Muun a few questions, and Lah offered to get the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] some medical attention. Darth Plagueis asked to talk to the captain alone and asked for her to take him to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], a trip for which he would pay handsomely. Lah informed the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] that everyone aboard the ''Woebegone'' are equals, so they would decide jointly. The group discussed their options, but decided to contact the authorities on Bal'demnic. Then, Lah informed Plagueis of their decision. The Sith warned her not to make that decision, and when she didn't back down, Plagueis attacked her with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], then went after the rest of the crew. Lah died at the hands of the Sith Lord, his lightsaber almost [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitating]] her.<ref name="DP" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I can be convincing when I want to be.|Ellin Lah|<ref name="DP" />}}
Lah believed that those aboard the ''Woebegone'' were equals, and she valued each crew members' thoughts. While on Bal'demnic she was known to gamble and drink.<ref name="DP" />
